chameleon.details:
Every shard has its own ID — a rarity letter (C→U→R→E→L = Common→Legendary) and a number: §fGrove§r (§fC1§r), §aBramble§r (§aU1§r), §9Sylvan§r (§9R1§r), §5Terra§r (§5E1§r), §6Tenebris§r (§6L1§r).

Fusing §6Chameleon §r+ a shard with ID §fXn§r gives the next 3 numbers as results: X(n+1), X(n+2), X(n+3). Example:§6 Chameleon§r + §fGrove§r (§fC1§r) → §fC2§r, §fC3§r, §fC4§r.

The chains have gaps (some numbers don't exist). A gap or the end of a rarity is filled by the first shard of the NEXT rarity, counted by the number of gaps in the window. Example: §6Chameleon §r+ §fChill§r (§fC12§r, no §fC13§r) → §aU1§r, §fC14§r, §fC15§r. §6Chameleon§r + §fCretan Bull§r (§fC39§r, end of Common) → §aU1§r, §aU2§r, §aU3§r. Legendary is the ceiling: there, gaps simply trim the output.

etherdrake.details:
MULTIPLIER: it multiplies, it does not stack additively.

This percent multiplies the whole stat itself — together with everything gear, pets and reforges give you. At level 10, +1% means x1.01 of your stat.

That's how it differs from % damage attributes: those add into a shared pool and get weaker the beefier you are. This one works off your stat, so the bigger the stat, the bigger the gain.

Measured in game: Crit Damage 1214.77% -> 1226.92%, exactly x1.01.

hideongeon.details:
The attribute adds §a1 Quality§r per level to a boss reward chest — at level 10, §a+10§r.

Chest Quality is a budget, not a chance. Every item has its own Quality cost and its own §eWeight§r — its weight in the roll. If there isn't enough budget for an item, it doesn't take part in the roll at all.

Here's how it's calculated: the chest's base Quality is multiplied by the score multiplier for S+, then by §eTreasure Accessories§r, and only then the §eBoss Luck§r perk and the Catacombs Box attribute are added. Your bonus comes as an addend at the very end, on top of all the multipliers.

§6Necron's Handle§r costs §a360 Quality§r on §cFloor VII§r and §a380§r on §4Master Mode VII§r, with a weight of §a15§r and §a18§r. It only drops from the §8Bedrock Chest§r.

Base chances: §a0.1094%§r on F7 — one handle per §a914§r runs. On M7 §a0.1296%§r, that is §a772§r runs. A fully upgraded S+ with all bonuses (this attribute among them) pulls M7 up to §a0.2003%§r — §a499§r runs, one and a half times less grind.

[§aEcho of Boxes§r](shard:cuboa) boosts all Box attributes by §a2%§r per level. Level 10 turns your §a+10§r into §a+12 Quality§r, and with a level 10 [§6Echo of Echoes§r](shard:tiamat) attribute the bonus becomes §a+13§r.

MULTIPLIER: it multiplies, it does not stack additively.

This percent multiplies the whole stat itself — together with everything gear, pets and reforges give you. At level 10, +1% means x1.01 of your stat.

end stone protector.details:
MULTIPLIER: it multiplies, it does not stack additively.

This percent multiplies the whole stat itself — together with everything gear, pets and reforges give you. At level 10, +1% means x1.01 of your stat.

That's how it differs from % damage attributes: those add into a shared pool and get weaker the beefier you are. This one works off your stat, so the bigger the stat, the bigger the gain.

methods.text: Drops as a reward when killing the boss §cEndstone Protector§r in [Dragon's Nest](loc:dragons_nest).

bruiser.details:
This bonus is §7additive§r — its % goes into one shared damage pool with everything else (combat level, gear, enchants, other shards), not a separate multiplier. The more damage % you already have, the less each point adds.

Belongs to the §cRuler§r category and is boosted by the [§5Echo of Ruler§r](shard:caiman) attribute, which is itself amplified by [§6Echo of Echoes§r](shard:tiamat).
